app.name: Mooral Business Suite
app.tagline: Run your whole business from one place
locale.label: Language
auth.mfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaEnrollBody: Owner and manager accounts need an authenticator app. Add this key to the app for {account}, then enter the code it shows.
auth.mfaSecretHint: Type or paste this key into your authenticator app. It is shown only now.
auth.mfaCodeHint: Open your authenticator app and type the code for this business.
auth.mfaCodeHintEnrol: The app shows a new code every 30 seconds.
auth.mfaInvalidCode: That code is not valid. Check the app and try the current code.
auth.mfaInvalidCodeLeft: {count, plural, one {That code is not valid. # attempt left.} other {That code is not valid. # attempts left.}}
auth.mfaTooMany: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then sign in again.
auth.mfaExpired: This sign-in step has expired. Sign in again.
auth.mfaRecoverySaved: You have {count} recovery codes. Each one lets you sign in once if you lose your phone. They are not shown again, so keep them somewhere safe.
auth.mfaRecoveryBody: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification.
auth.subtitle: Use the email and password of your business account.
auth.secureNote: Your session ends automatically after 8 hours.
auth.chooseBusinessBody: This account belongs to more than one business. Pick the one you want to open.
auth.locked: {minutes, plural, one {Too many attempts. Try again in # minute.} other {Too many attempts. Try again in # minutes.}}
auth.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

profile.binHint: The Business Identification Number issued by the NBR. Leave it blank if the business is not registered.
profile.digitsHint: Used on screens and on printed documents.
profile.vatHint: Turn on if this business charges VAT.
profile.readOnly: Only an owner or manager can change the business profile.
profile.noChanges: There are no changes to save.
profile.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
profile.loadFailed: The business profile could not be loaded.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
